author: AstroPizza
body:
Setnext community event
16th July {Saturday}
8:30pm BST


Rules:
All server rules apply.
No map will be played twice
do not spam for your map to be chosen , msg a member running the event and it will get seen to.

Explanation
A set-next event will be a period when the community will take over a server for 1-2 hours during
this time the community can choose maps to play. The idea being to let you guys choose what
maps are played so everyone get's to play their favourite maps and enjoy them together!

Hosts:Grapesmoothie & Pizza
